title: Azusawa Kohane — A Heart-Pounding World〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: COL

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Argh! Darn it!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Yes, I win this round.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Everyone from GLaP day's so good...
No matter how many times I try, I still can't beat any of them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (At this rate, will I even be able to...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time to be worrying right now. As hard as this all is, I have to find a way to win...!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
You must be exhausted, Kohane.
Why don't we take a break?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? O-Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Haha. I know you already want to battle again, but you'll lose your voice if you push yourself too hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
Then, let's take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Still, it can't be easy juggling this with being a student. I mean, you had school earlier today, right?

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: She did dash over to come train right after classes too. You probably don't have much free time, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... No, I don't.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'm sure all of you experienced the same thing. I heard that you also formed your teams when you were still in school...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
We always got together right after school got out and sang until we went blue.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: And the teachers kept coming after us about taking supplementary classes. They kept saying, “You're going to be held back if you don't show up for them!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Really? I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Held back...
Come to think of it, some of us went through something similar...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that we were all able to become second-years together.)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: How's life as a student, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Me?
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Lately, we practice every morning before school starts.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And after school, we travel to different venues or stay around here to practice. Then we practice again at night at Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Hmm, that wasn't what I was expecting to hear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: I was just expecting to hear that you've been hanging out with friends and stuff since you are still a student...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
My friends have also been really busy, so we haven't been able to hang out much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Some are hard at work as idols, some are debuting as a professional band...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: Wow, credit where credit's due. Kids these days are so mature at such a young age...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, they're all really hard workers...!
And seeing them do that makes me want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I've been practicing on my own as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:
I see.
When you put it that way, you sorta fall into our category.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: You love singing more than anything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: More than anything...?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Well, that much is obvious.
She wouldn't be here if she were some run-of-the-mill singer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Yeah, I'm not exactly what you'd call normal, am I?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I haven't really given it much thought since I've been practicing after school ever since I formed a team with An and the others...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In retrospect, all I really have been doing is singing.)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Still, not being a normal student is pretty fun, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes!
Singing nonstop has been really fun!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:
That's what we like to hear!
Otherwise, you can't really call yourself a singer!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Anyway, wanna get back to practicing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
Before I cool down too much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, let's resume!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Okay, we're ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to keep not being a normal student. I'm going to keep practicing and singing like there's no tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to keep taking everything I experience and channel it all into my music!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to propel myself forward and help make our dream come true!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here I go!
